name: b2b_saas
description: B2B SaaS — solid metrics, strong team.
pitch_summary: Notifi is a B2B SaaS platform for IT operations teams to centralize on-call alerting and incident response. We integrate with PagerDuty, Datadog, and Slack. We're SOC2 Type II compliant and have 47 enterprise customers including two Fortune 500 companies. ARR is $1.8M growing 22% quarter-over-quarter with 92% net dollar retention. Our team has 11 engineers with prior experience at PagerDuty, Datadog, and AWS.
